title.name: Mythic Masters
title.subtitle:
Grey aliens dropped a magic book on you and ran.
Now you have one job: catch Earth's cryptids, or the world ends.
title.tagline:
Explore a big open world, built from real places.
Find each region's cryptids where they really live.
Beat each region's boss to open the next one.
Train your team. Take on bigger, rarer cryptids in arcade-style fights.
Become the best cryptid collector there is.
title.startOver: Burn the book and start over? Click again
imprint: Bound in Cedar Bark of Leeds Point
title.plateCaption: The Book. It holds every cryptid you catch. Open it to call them out to fight.

starters.heading: The Bog Witch
starters.witch: "You fell out of the sky, you and that loud one. Nobody believes you. I'm not sure I do. And now you've got their book, have you? Keep it shut in my yard. Five of these beasts came to my door this year, and they eat all my food. Take three. Then go."
starters.after: She will not touch the Book. It fell with you, it is warm, and it is yours. Her camp is at Leeds Point. Come back when you have news.
starters.hodag: A hodag pup from the north woods. Hot inside, hard as rock outside. Slow to turn, and slower to fall.
starters.squonk: A squonk. It weeps, it hides, and its tears are a tide that puts out any fire.
starters.agropelter: An agropelter out of a hollow tree. It throws branches, and it holds a grudge.
starters.jackalope: A jackalope. Six kilos of antlers and attitude. Faster than anything in these pines.
starters.tatzelwurm: A tatzelwurm down from the Alps, cat-faced and four-legged. Its bite is poison and its breath is frost.

versus.name: Mythic Masters
versus.librarianTag: Size and weight are real. The small one can win.
versus.bookTag: The Book of Things That Probably Exist. It is not responsible for what it summons.
